method: Official institution pages checked against named undergraduate cohort and annualized where explicitly semester-based; fee allowances kept distinct from required fees.

tuitionInState.cohort: Full-time dependent undergraduate, Autumn, Winter and Spring quarters; residence hall or off-campus.
tuitionInState.definition: Annual undergraduate tuition for three quarters, before aid. Fees, housing, food and other expenses excluded.

tuitionOutOfState.definition: Annual undergraduate tuition for three quarters, before aid. Fees, housing, food and other expenses excluded.

feesInState.cohort: Full-time dependent undergraduate, Autumn, Winter and Spring quarters; residence hall or off-campus.
feesInState.definition: Estimated annual Student Fees Allowance, not a fixed mandatory-fee bill. Includes campus health service, student activities, house dues, housing technology and course enrollment fees.

feesOutOfState.definition: Estimated annual Student Fees Allowance, not a fixed mandatory-fee bill. Includes campus health service, student activities, house dues, housing technology and course enrollment fees.

budget.title: Standard undergraduate budget
budget.notes: Travel varies and is additional. New students also pay $775 in one-time orientation and document fees. Health insurance is required; Cardinal Care coverage costs extra unless waived with qualifying insurance. Your aid offer and circumstances determine what you actually pay.

tuitionInState.cohort: New 2026–2027 undergraduate entering cohort, fall and spring semesters; residency determines tuition.
tuitionInState.definition: Annual tuition derived as two semesters of $7,101; nonresidents also pay two semesters of $19,635 supplemental tuition. Fees, health insurance and living costs excluded. Estimates subject to change.

tuitionOutOfState.cohort: New 2026–2027 undergraduate entering cohort, fall and spring semesters; residency determines tuition.
tuitionOutOfState.definition: Annual tuition derived as two semesters of $7,101; nonresidents also pay two semesters of $19,635 supplemental tuition. Fees, health insurance and living costs excluded. Estimates subject to change.

feesInState.sourceField: Student Services + Campus + Transit + Instructional Resilience fees, × 2 semesters
feesInState.cohort: New 2026–2027 undergraduate entering cohort, fall and spring semesters; residency determines tuition.
feesInState.definition: Annual recurring fees derived as two semesters of student services $693, campus $936, transit $236 and instructional resilience $141. Excludes waivable health insurance, one-time document fee and program-specific charges.

budget.title: New student · campus residence hall
budget.notes: 2026–2027 new undergraduate cohort living in a campus residence hall. Nonresidents add $39,270 in supplemental tuition. Health insurance may be waived with equivalent coverage. One-time document fees and individual/program charges may be additional; continuing cohorts and other living arrangements have different budgets. Estimates may change.
